# Pixel IMS 5G 2.2.9

Makes the Field Test radio log summary readable. Version code 41 updates existing public GitHub installations in place.

- **Clearer radio log summary:** In 2.2.8 the EN-DC list matched ordinary registration lines that merely print `isEnDcAvailable`, so it filled with noise. It is replaced by a **5G / EN-DC timeline of real changes only**: NR advertised and EN-DC available per SIM with the serving channel, 5G state transitions (for example *5G available, LTE connected* or *NR connected*), status-bar 5G changes, RIL EN-DC capability lines and SCG failures. Duplicate reports from several layers collapse to where they settled.
- **Last boot and capability log timing:** The capture shows when the phone last booted and marks each modem capability log as *at*, *since* or *before* the last boot, so a capability written during startup is easy to spot.

## Known limitation: Pixel 10 Pro XL 5G

Some Pixel 10 Pro XL users stay on LTE where other phones on the same SIM and tower get n78 5G. **2.2.9 does not fix this**; it improves the diagnostic capture. A useful test: at the affected tower, turn airplane mode on for 30 seconds, off again, then run **Field Test → Radio log capture** and check whether a new capability log appears *since last boot* and whether the timeline reaches *NR connected*.

## Updating

Existing public GitHub builds update in place with `Pixel-IMS-5G-v2.2.9.apk`, signed with the established public release identity.
